legend: A group of friends is planning a road trip from Patras to Thessaloniki. They have chosen their main route, but visiting a gas station may require a detour.
Their car travels along a main route from position $$$0$$$ to position $$$d$$$. On a full tank, it can travel $$$l$$$ kilometers. Initially, its tank is full.

There are $$$n$$$ refueling stations. Station $$$i$$$ is connected to the main route at position $$$p_i$$$. To visit it, the car leaves the route, travels $$$a_i/2$$$ kilometers to the station, fills its tank completely, and travels $$$a_i/2$$$ kilometers back to the same position on the main route. Thus, visiting this station adds $$$a_i$$$ kilometers to the journey. Fuel is consumed on both parts of the detour, at the same constant rate as on the main route.

The car moves only forward along the main route. The positions of the stations it visits must strictly increase. The car may arrive at a station or at the destination with an empty tank. The distance traveled between consecutive refuelings, as well as before the first and after the last refueling, must not exceed $$$l$$$.
Find the minimum total distance the car must travel to reach position $$$d$$$, including all detours. If reaching the destination is impossible, report this.
input: The first line contains an integer $$$d$$$ ($$$1 \le d \le 10^9$$$), the length of the main route in kilometers.
The second line contains an integer $$$l$$$ ($$$1 \le l \le 10^6$$$), the distance in kilometers that the car can travel on a full tank.
The third line contains an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$0 \le n \le 10^5$$$), the number of stations.

Each of the next $$$n$$$ lines contains two integers $$$p_i$$$ and $$$a_i$$$ ($$$1 \le p_i \le d-1$$$, $$$0 \le a_i \le 10^6$$$), the position of station $$$i$$$ on the main route and the total length of its detour. The stations are given in strictly increasing order of position: $$$p_1  \lt  p_2  \lt  \dots  \lt  p_n$$$. If $$$d=1$$$, then $$$n=0$$$.
output: Print one integer: the minimum total distance traveled, or $$$-1$$$ if the destination cannot be reached.

legend.ai: 一群朋友计划从帕特雷斯驾车前往塞萨洛尼基。他们已经选定了主要路线，但前往加油站可能需要绕行。
他们的汽车沿着一条主路线从位置 $$$0$$$ 行驶到位置 $$$d$$$。油箱加满时，汽车可以行驶 $$$l$$$ 千米。初始时，油箱是满的。
共有 $$$n$$$ 个加油站。加油站 $$$i$$$ 位于主路线的位置 $$$p_i$$$ 处。若要前往该加油站，汽车需要驶离主路线，行驶 $$$a_i/2$$$ 千米到达加油站，将油箱加满，然后再行驶 $$$a_i/2$$$ 千米返回主路线上的同一位置。因此，访问该加油站会使旅程增加 $$$a_i$$$ 千米。绕行的两段路程均会消耗燃油，且消耗速率与在主路线上行驶时相同。
汽车只能沿主路线向前行驶。它访问的各个加油站的位置必须严格递增。汽车到达某个加油站或目的地时可以为空油箱。在连续两次加油之间，以及第一次加油之前和最后一次加油之后行驶的距离都不得超过 $$$l$$$。
求汽车到达位置 $$$d$$$ 所需行驶的最小总距离，包括所有绕行路程。如果无法到达目的地，请报告这一情况。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$d$$$($$$1 \le d \le 10^9$$$)，表示主路线的长度(单位：千米)。
第二行包含一个整数 $$$l$$$($$$1 \le l \le 10^6$$$)，表示汽车加满一箱油后可以行驶的距离(单位：千米)。
第三行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$0 \le n \le 10^5$$$)，表示车站的数量。

接下来的 $$$n$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $$$p_i$$$ 和 $$$a_i$$$($$$1 \le p_i \le d-1$$$、$$$0 \le a_i \le 10^6$$$)，分别表示车站 $$$i$$$ 在主线路上的位置以及其绕行路线的总长度。车站按照位置严格递增的顺序给出：$$$p_1  \lt  p_2  \lt  \dots  \lt  p_n$$$。如果 $$$d=1$$$，则 $$$n=0$$$。

output.ai: 输出一个整数：行驶的最小总距离；如果无法到达目的地，则输出 $$$-1$$$。
